card.text: Dactyl, discovered beside Ida in Galileo images, was the first moon found orbiting an asteroid.

introduction.text: Dactyl, discovered beside Ida in Galileo images, was the first moon found orbiting an asteroid. Approximate orbital placement. The 1993 encounter did not determine a unique orbit; the present orbital phase is illustrative. A synchronous orientation is assumed, not measured.

shape.title: Galileo shape estimate
shape.summary: A smooth ellipsoid at the dimensions measured from Galileo images: 1.6 × 1.4 × 1.2 km. Craters and surface imagery are not represented; the grid marks missing imagery.
